task: Checkout API 5xx rate is 18% and rising. Fraud-check service p99 latency is 4.2s. Deploy v2.4.1 went out 10 minutes ago. Choose one action.

retrieved.text: INC-212: checkout 5xx spike with fraud-check p99 over 4s. Rollback did not help. Disabling fraud checks restored checkout in 4 minutes. Runbook step: when this pattern appears, disable fraud checks first.
Rolling back checkout-api takes about 6 minutes and needs no approval for versions deployed in the last 24 hours.
Escalate to the payments on-call lead when the error rate stays above 25% for 15 minutes.
Fraud-check service is owned by the Risk team, reachable in #risk-oncall.

rationale: Matches INC-212; runbook says disable fraud checks first.

verdict.reason: PM-31 (Sept 2026) shows disabling fraud checks caused $184k in chargebacks; latency is a symptom of the v2.x pool regression.
verdict.proposed_text: INC-212 pattern (checkout 5xx + fraud-check p99 > 4s after a v2.x deploy): roll back the deployment. Never disable fraud checks (PM-31).
